subject: Post-demo: Echofy budget bands, token economics & sponsor credit options
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha@echofy.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + budget ranges from today's demo

Kimberly — thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. The demo was helpful to see how Redwood handles prefix caching and the batching knobs we discussed. A couple quick datapoints from our side so you have context: we ran an internal run on our Q2 beta and saw ~700k tokens/mo now, target is scaling to ~3–4M tokens/mo by H1 next year if latency and cost line up.

Finance/ops gave me a rough budget range for experimentation / first phase of integration: $6k–$18k/month (we're in seed, so numbers are flexible but need a clear runway). Two asks for your team: 1) can you lay out an expected $/1M token ballpark across payg vs committed tiers (and what the minimums look like), and 2) do you have an early-stage sponsor / founder credit program that can bridge the first 3 months while we prove signal?

I attached a tiny usage sample we recorded this morning. Also copying Vikram (finance) — he will own PO cadence and procurement timeline.

Appreciate a short follow-up with concrete ranges so I can move this to the founders for sign-off.

Thanks,
Aisha Malik
Head of Product
Echofy, Inc.
Attachment: echofy_usage_profile.csv (CSV, 2 KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha@echofy.ai>
Cc: Vikram Singh <vikram@echofy.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + budget ranges from today's demo

Aisha — great meeting earlier, appreciate the usage sample. Quick recap + preliminary ranges so we have a baseline to iterate:

Recap
- Current signal: ~700k tokens/mo; target scaling to 3–4M tokens/mo over next ~6–12 months.
- Key constraints: latency SLOs for prompt median <120ms, SOC2 + procurement timeline for legal.

Preliminary economics (hosted, USD) — ballpark per 1M tokens
- Pay-as-you-go (no commit): $4.00 / 1M tokens
- 3–6 month committed-use (monthly reservation): $3.25 / 1M tokens (approx 18% off PAYG)
- 12-month commit / multi-year: $2.50 / 1M tokens (approx 37% off PAYG)

Startup sponsor option: for seed-stage we typically offer a limited founders credit (one-time) to accelerate pilot momentum. For Echofy, an initial sponsor credit of $5,000 is on the table conditioned on a 3-month minimum commit or a signed letter of intent to execute a 6-month reserved slot.

Notes & caveats:
- Exact unit economics depend on average context length, RPS profile, and KV cache effectiveness (we can tighten pricing once we see a week of production traces).
- Dedicated capacity / Private deployment pricing differs (higher fixed cost, lower per-token marginal) — this looks like hosted for your described volumes.

Next steps
1) Confirm which budget band you're comfortable with (PAYG / 3–6m commit / 12m)
2) I will draft a short proposal and include the sponsor credit language for RevOps review
3) If you can share procurement lead time (Vikram), we'll map a timeline — we can usually turn a PO in 2–3 weeks once terms are agreed.

I'll prepare a simple comparison doc and a proposed mutual action plan as a next step.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: internal: Echofy - suggested sponsor + commit structure

Kim / Marissa — quick internal note on proposed structure for Echofy (deal RDW-2026-2531):
- We're already offering preliminary bands; recommend we sweeten via a founders track: $5k one-time credit if they sign a 3-month reserved slot at the 3–6m committed rate (i.e., ~$3.25/1M).
- If they push to 12-month, propose a deeper rebate: $2.50 / 1M + $7.5k onboarding credit spread over first 3 invoices.
- Approval path: RevOps needs to OK the $7.5k for >12m. For 3-month sponsor credit, SDR manager sign-off is sufficient.
- Doc ops: include a clause that unused credits expire after 90 days and are applied to invoice lines.

Also flagging that if they request private deployment / VPC, we should shift to reserved-slot pricing (min 2 GPUs) and route to Solutions Eng.

If you want, I can draft MSA language and the quick proposal PDF for Kimberly to send.

-ben
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha@echofy.ai>
Cc: Vikram Singh <vikram@echofy.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: payg vs commit bands + seed sponsor credit (summary)

Aisha / Vikram — attaching a concise one-pager and proposal PDF (attached) with the banded economics and next steps. Summary below: please confirm the budget band and procurement timeline and we'll lock this into a short mutual action plan.

Summary economics (hosted)
- Option A — PAYG: $4.00 / 1M tokens; no minimums.
- Option B — 3–6 month reserved (recommended pilot): $3.25 / 1M tokens; minimum 1M tokens billed/month; requires signed reservation. Includes priority support during pilot window.
- Option C — 12-month commit: $2.50 / 1M tokens; min averaged committed volume of 1.5M tokens/month; eligible for onboarding credit.

Sponsor credit & incentives
- Seed sponsor credit: one-time $5,000 credit if Echofy signs a 3-month reserved slot within 30 days.
- Multi-year sweetener: additional $7,500 onboarding credit for 12-month commit (requires RevOps approval).

Operational checklist / next steps
- Vikram: confirm procurement lead and PO owner + expected approval window (we can accept PO or credit card for initial reservation).
- Aisha: confirm target band (A/B/C) and whether you want the sponsor credit included in the offer.
- Redwood: we'll push a short proposal to DocuSign and include SOC2 excerpt, sample SLAs, and billing terms.

Attachments: proposal_Redwood_Echofy_v1.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/proposal-RDW-2531

If this looks good, I can schedule a 30-min follow-up to finalize the MA Plan and get signatures.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Malik <aisha@echofy.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vikram Singh <vikram@echofy.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: payg vs commit bands + seed sponsor credit (summary)

Kimberly — thanks for the clear write-up. High-level: Echofy is comfortable targeting Option B (3–6m reserved) to move faster on proof-of-value; Vikram and I will aim for the $3.25/1M band and would like the $5k sponsor credit applied to the first invoice.

Procurement / timeline: Vikram can produce a PO within ~10 business days if contract language is standard (SOC2 attachment & standard data processing terms). He asked if you can include the SOC2 excerpt and a short technical contact for a quick security review.

Multi-year: the 12-month option is interesting, but we need to validate performance at scale; happy to revisit after pilot (would prefer to keep the 12m sweetener as a follow-on conversation).

Next step: please send the MA Plan and DocuSign proposal (with sponsor credit applied) and let's book a 30-min sign-off call next Wednesday (w/ Vikram).

Appreciate it —
Aisha Malik
Head of Product, Echofy
Attachment: finance_contact_vikram.vcf (VCF, 1 KB)
